paras: Draco boschmai is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.
The specific name, boschmai, is in honor of Dutch zoologist Hilbrand Boschma.
Within Indonesia D. boschmai is found on the islands of Adonara, Flores, Komodo, Lombok, Rinca, Sulawesi, Sumba, and Sumbawa.
D. boschmai may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 9 cm (3.5 in). The patagium is dark brown.
